description: What's in a skincare, makeup, hair or body product and what the EU Cosmetics Regulation says about each ingredient, from the European Commission's CosIng annexes: banned (Annex II, with any exception), restricted with the maximum concentration, where it may be used and the required warnings (Annex III), fragrance allergens the EU requires on the label, and preservatives, UV filters and colorants allowed only within limits. Send the ingredient list (from the package or the brand's product page), or a product name with brand or a barcode to look it up in Open Beauty Facts. Recalls and EU Safety Gate alerts naming the brand (EU, UK and Canada) are included. Use when someone asks what's in a product, whether an ingredient is allowed or limited, or which fragrance allergens it has. It doesn't rate products or say what suits someone's skin; you advise. Not medical advice. Not for medicines (use check_medicine) or food (use check_food).

barcode.description: UPC or EAN on the package

ingredients.description: The INCI ingredient list, comma separated, e.g. 'Aqua, Glycerin, Niacinamide, Phenoxyethanol'

product.description: Product name with brand, e.g. 'CeraVe Moisturizing Cream'

name: check_cosmetic
title: Cosmetics: what's in skincare and makeup, and EU rules
